title: C2 Milestone 12
completion_message: ¡Fenomenal! Has superado el Milestone 12. Entiendes la automatización de la IA, los cuellos de botella logísticos, el verdadero empoderamiento de liderazgo y cómo sobrevivir a una crisis de relaciones públicas. Tu visión corporativa es implacable.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. AI & Automation: 
- Machine learning & Generative AI. 
- Algorithm bias. 
- Disruption & Redundancies (Despidos). 
- Scalability. 

2. Supply Chain & Logistics: 
- Just-in-Time (JIT) manufacturing. 
- Bottleneck (Cuello de botella). 
- Lead time & Backlog. 
- Procurement & Outsourcing.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 12, Global Operations. This exam tests your mastery of recent high-level business topics. First, AI and Automation. You need to know terms like Machine learning, Algorithm bias, market Disruption, system Scalability, and employee Redundancies. Second, Supply Chain and Logistics. Be ready to talk about Just-in-Time manufacturing, finding the Bottleneck, managing a Backlog, understanding Lead time, Procurement, and Outsourcing.

parts.visual:
3. Leadership Styles: 
- Micromanagement vs Empowerment. 
- Hands-on vs Hands-off. 
- Laissez-faire. 
- The glass ceiling. 
- Lead by example. 

4. Crisis Communication (PR): 
- Damage control & Cover-up. 
- Press release & Backlash. 
- Scapegoat (Chivo expiatorio). 
- Downplay & Clear the air.
parts.audio: Third, Leadership Styles. The difference between Micromanagement and Empowerment. Being Hands-on or Hands-off. Laissez-faire approaches, breaking the glass ceiling, and leading by example. Finally, Crisis Communication and PR. How to do Damage control, issue a Press release, manage a public Backlash, spot a Cover-up or a Scapegoat, and Clear the air. Good luck on the exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu capacidad de gestión operativa y comunicacional en esta prueba final del bloque.

questions.question: The recruiting software was rejecting applicants over 50 years old because of a severe ____ bias in its code.
Instead of storing parts in a warehouse, we use ____-in-time logistics, so parts arrive the morning we need them.
I can't work under this manager. He checks my emails before I send them. His ____ is toxic.
When the video of the defective product went viral, the PR team immediately started doing ____ control.
A massive innovation that completely changes or destroys how an industry operates is called market ____.
The factory produces fast, but the shipping team is slow. Shipping is the ____ slowing down the whole company.
Unlike my last boss who never left his office, the new CEO is very ____. She works directly with the engineers.
The company's decision to ban remote work caused a furious ____ from the employees.
If you want to buy new servers, you have to talk to the ____ department to negotiate with suppliers.
The board made the mistake, but they fired the junior analyst as a ____ to protect themselves.
We had a server outage for a week, so we now have a huge ____ of unprocessed orders. (Trabajo acumulado).
Because the new AI software can do the job of 20 writers, the company announced 20 ____. (Despidos).
He has a very relaxed, ____ management style. He trusts his team and never interferes.
The CEO tried to ____ the danger of the security flaw, saying it was 'just a minor bug'. (Minimizar).
The time it takes from when a customer clicks 'buy' to when the product arrives at their door is the ____ time.
We need a cloud database with infinite ____ so it doesn't crash on Black Friday.
The problem wasn't the accounting error. It was the illegal ____ organized by the executives to hide it.
We hired a firm in India to handle our IT support. We are ____ our IT operations.
A great manager gives their team the tools, authority, and trust to make decisions. This is called ____.
There are rumors that the company is going bankrupt. We need to hold a meeting to ____ the air.
____ learning. (Aprendizaje automático con M)
A massive ____. (Disrupción del mercado con D)
The ____ chain. (Cadena de suministro con S)
A shipping ____. (Cuello de botella con B)
Toxic ____. (Microgestión con M)
A ____-on boss. (Involucrado/Práctico con H)
____ control. (Control de daños con D)
A public ____. (Reacción negativa furiosa con B)
He's a ____. (Chivo expiatorio con S)
An illegal ____-up. (Encubrimiento con C)
